content.text:
Cross Country Healthcare: too few of its open jobs post an hourly rate to measure; each job shows the pay its own posting states (posted on travel assignments, as weekly pay).
Its jobs by pay: https://carejobs.now/?platform=cross-country-healthcare&sort=pay&country=all#live-roles. Its pay: https://carejobs.now/employers/cross-country-healthcare#pay. Typical pay is the 25th percentile of what jobs pay (the middle of each advertised range) to the 90th-percentile advertised ceiling. Method: https://carejobs.now/methodology.
